title: Run a single prompt through the harness_run Agentic Recipe
narrative: Fangore wants the classic one-shot harness path to be a named control pattern he can discover beside other recipes, not a special-case CLI only. He lists the catalog, opens harness_run, binds a prompt and mock backend, and gets final text from the same graph executor used for other recipes. Complements `fangore_backend_describe_recipe` and `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `harness_run` (`HarnessRunTemplate`): prepare → harness_loop → render. `CliInstrumentor` verb `run_recipe` calls `recipe_runner.run_harness_recipe` / `list_recipes` with `HarnessPrepareRunner`, `HarnessLoopRunner`, and `HarnessRenderRunner`. Soft points cover backend, family, model, system prompt, max turns, and runner kinds. CLI `run` and `recipes run harness_run` share this path. Node components under `harness_loop` reuse harness `inference` / `tool_call` / `turn_start` kinds.
